I’m a Software Engineer & Full-Stack Web Developer specializing in software engineering, UI/UX design, and systems development.

What drives my work

I’m interested in understanding problems, questioning assumptions, and turning ideas into useful digital experiences. My work spans web interfaces, backend services, and the databases that connect them.

Learning through practice

I am pursuing a Bachelor of Software Engineering at Cavendish University Uganda. My interests include innovation, emerging technologies, and computer networking. I develop my skills through projects, technical study, and hands-on practice.

Community & collaboration

As part of Team Kodepalz, I earned third place in the November 2026 IEEE Cavendish University Student Branch and CUUCSA launch hackathon. I also volunteered at the launch. My earlier experience includes cancer awareness work recognized in 2023 and an Educate! leadership and entrepreneurship programme completed at Nyakasura School in 2022.

Beyond technology

I enjoy novels and history, and I value critical thinking, creativity, and continuous learning. These interests shape how I explore ideas and approach unfamiliar problems.
